question: Has gateway 2026.7.1 completed enough Windows setup validation to replace 2026.6.11 as the default known-good version?
rationale: The constant change is mechanically correct and the upstream release has positive Windows promotion evidence, but designating a release as known-good requires a human release-readiness judgment based on the repository’s setup validation evidence.

options.title: Validate then promote
options.body: Run the repository-required suites and a current-head fresh setup proof, then merge if installation, pairing, and gateway connectivity succeed.

options.title: Retain the current LKG
options.body: Keep 2026.6.11 pinned until complete Windows setup proof for 2026.7.1 is available.

recommendation.title: Validate then promote
recommendation.body: Run the repository-required suites and a current-head fresh setup proof, then merge if installation, pairing, and gateway connectivity succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available Windows repository routing candidate from recent release, packaging, and CI-adjacent history, although exact ownership is uncertain.
